sourceInvestigation.conclusion: Most production source_host_read time was cloud response-body waiting, not cached disk reading. A later same-object comparison shows the configured proxy was much faster than native Node direct transfer; both Node versions showed slow direct reads with low event-loop delay. Historical per-packet loss/router causes were not captured.
